Pip had one tiny seed, and everyone laughed at him.
Plant that? It will never grow!
But Pip dug a small hole, and tucked the seed inside.
Day after day, he watered it.
Nothing happened. Not one single leaf.
His friends got bored, and walked away.
Then one morning, a green sprout pushed through the soil!
It grew taller than the houses, and filled with golden apples.
Now everyone came running back, and Pip shared every single one.
Good things take time. So keep watering your seed.
